+def read_removal_requests(options):
+    """Collect open Ubuntu bugs tagged "remove", by source package."""
+    global RemovalRequests
+    RemovalRequests = {}
+
+    logging.debug("Reading removal requests")
+    for task in options.distribution.searchTasks(tags=["remove"]):
+        base, _, package = task.target_link.rpartition("/+source/")
+        if base.endswith("/ubuntu") and package:
+            RemovalRequests.setdefault(package, []).append(task)
+
+
+def show_removal_requests(package):
+    """Show open removal request bugs for a source package."""
+    tasks = RemovalRequests.get(package)
+    if not tasks:
+        return
+    print("Removal requests:")
+    for task in tasks:
+        print("\t%s [%s]" % (task.title, task.status))
+        print("\t%s" % task.web_link)
+    print()
+
